title: LRU Cache
prompt: Design an LRU cache; give the optimised solution with time and space complexity.

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
prompt: Return the count of the longest continuous sequence of numbers in an unsorted array (reported example [4,88,3,9,0,2,1]). The same report mentions a hashmap + sorting array problem; the exact variant is ambiguous.
follow_ups: Contiguous variant: longest continuous increasing subarray (LeetCode 674).
Do it in O(n) without sorting.

title: Synchronous vs asynchronous calls in Spring Boot
prompt: Explain synchronous vs asynchronous calls in Spring Boot (asked alongside some design discussion).
follow_ups: How does @Async work underneath (proxy, executor) and why does self-invocation bypass it?
When would you use a message queue instead of an async call?

title: Design a distributed queue with multiple producers and consumers
prompt: Design a distributed queue system with multiple producers and consumers. The round tested system design fundamentals and coding together.
follow_ups: Ordering per partition; consumer groups and offsets.
Delivery semantics: at-least-once vs exactly-once; idempotent consumers.
Code a thread-safe bounded blocking queue (see design-bounded-blocking-queue).

title: Find Peak Element
prompt: Find a peak element in an array (one coding question, one hour).
follow_ups: O(log n) with binary search.

title: Kafka architecture
prompt: Explain Kafka's architecture (asked with core Java, Redis, Spring Boot, SQL and system design basics).
follow_ups: How do partitions trade ordering against parallelism?
What happens on a consumer-group rebalance?

title: Redis: how it works and the algorithms behind it
prompt: Redis questions, reported as 'Redis algorithms' (asked with Kafka architecture, core Java, Spring Boot, SQL).
follow_ups: Eviction policies (approximate LRU/LFU) and TTL expiry.
Cache-aside vs write-through; cache stampede.

title: SQL query optimization
prompt: SQL query optimization: how would you make a slow query fast? (asked with JVM internals)
follow_ups: Read an EXPLAIN plan: sequential vs index scan, join strategy.
Composite index column order; covering indexes.
When does an index hurt?

title: SQL query optimization

title: JVM internals and memory allocation
prompt: JVM internals: how memory is allocated in Java and how the JVM manages it.
follow_ups: Heap generations and GC; why -Xmx does not bound process memory.

title: Write code that deadlocks, then fix it
prompt: Create a deadlock in Java and then remove it.
follow_ups: Lock ordering vs tryLock with timeout.

title: Code review: method that emails users and updates a DB flag
follow_ups: Connection pooling and closing resources.

title: Store {(1,a),(2,a),(3,b)} and retrieve efficiently
prompt: How would you store {(1,a),(2,a),(3,b)} and retrieve it efficiently?
follow_ups: Lookup by value as well as by key (reverse index / multimap).
